Please review the following job description:
This Software Engineer independently designs, develops, tests and maintains complex integration services for Wealth Brokerage and Trust. The role focuses on reliable movement of business data and orchestration of transactions across applications, platforms and organizational boundaries.
The engineer is expected to combine strong .NET/C#, SQL Server and Azure engineering with practical integration expertise across REST APIs, messaging, batch processing and managed file transfer. Python may be used where appropriate for data transformation, reconciliation, automation and engineering utilities.
The role works with product, architecture, data, security, operations and vendor teams to ensure integrations are secure, observable, supportable and aligned with business and control requirements.
Scope of responsibility
APIs and integration services supporting Brokerage and Trust client, adviser, operations, accounting, asset, cash, case and reporting processes.
Integration across .NET applications, SQL Server databases, Azure services, enterprise platforms, vendor systems and legacy environments.
Real-time, event-driven, scheduled and file-based data exchange, including validation, transformation, reconciliation and exception handling.
Production reliability, security, data protection, auditability, monitoring, capacity, disaster recovery and operational support.
Essential Duties And Responsibilities
Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.
Design and develop secure REST APIs, integration services, background processes and reusable components using .NET and C#.
Create clear interface contracts, canonical data structures, validation rules, error models, idempotency controls and versioning approaches.
Implement data integration using SQL Server, stored procedures where appropriate, data access frameworks, Azure services, messaging, batch processes and SFTP or managed file transfer.
Use Python for targeted data transformation, reconciliation, automation, test utilities or operational tooling where it provides a sensible engineering fit.
Apply authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets management, certificate handling, network controls and least-privilege principles to integration designs.
Build robust error handling, retry, dead-letter, replay, correlation and reconciliation capabilities so failures are visible and recoverable.
Develop automated unit, component, contract, integration, performance and regression tests. Support test-data and service-virtualization approaches where dependencies are constrained.
Instrument integrations with structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards and actionable alerting. Define operational runbooks and support procedures.
Partner with data owners and consumers to establish mappings, quality rules, lineage, retention and authoritative-source expectations.
Analyze and tune API, database, messaging and batch performance while accounting for throughput, latency, concurrency, capacity and downstream constraints.
Collaborate with architecture and platform teams on cloud migration, Azure PaaS patterns, network connectivity, deployment pipelines and reusable integration standards.
Troubleshoot complex defects and production incidents across application, API, database, identity, network and vendor boundaries. Complete root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
Participate throughout the software development lifecycle, including refinement, design reviews, coding, peer review, testing, deployment, release validation and production support.
Lead code and design reviews, mentor junior engineers and contribute patterns, libraries and documentation that improve integration delivery across Wealth Technology.

Area
Grade 111 expectation
NET and C#
Advanced development of APIs, services, background workers and integration components using established design, dependency-injection, configuration and error-handling practices.
API engineering
RESTful design, OpenAPI contracts, versioning, pagination, idempotency, throttling, security, consumer compatibility and lifecycle management.
SQL Server
Data modelling, querying, performance tuning, transactions, reconciliation, data-quality controls and safe integration with application services.
Microsoft Azure
Practical use of approved Azure PaaS, API, messaging, identity, secrets, monitoring, storage and deployment capabilities appropriate to the solution.

Mapping, transformation, validation, enrichment, lineage, reference data, batch orchestration and recoverable exception processing.
Messaging and events
Asynchronous integration, queues or topics, delivery semantics, correlation, ordering, replay and dead-letter handling.
Files and vendors
Secure SFTP or managed file transfer, encryption, naming and control totals, acknowledgements, reconciliation and vendor interface support.
Python
Targeted use for transformation, validation, reconciliation, automation, test harnesses and operational utilities, with production engineering controls.
Node.js and AWS
Working knowledge of Node.js services

title: Machine Learning Engineer
reason: Stack +66; Title fit +12; Title stack +10; Exp fit +10; US +10; Senior salary -45
description_preview:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
With a billion rides per year and counting, Lyft is solving hard problems in a rapidly growing domain with a lot of data and creative solutions in Rider, Driver, Marketplace, and beyond. While traditional approaches to optimization and problem decomposition are sufficient to disrupt transportation, building a next-generation platform for low-cost, ultra-immersive transportation to improve people's lives warrants modern ML utilizing petabyte-scale data. Our highly motivated Machine Learning Engineers work on these challenging problems and define solutions to directly impact various aspects of our core business.
The Fulfillment group, within the Marketplace at Lyft, is responsible for determining what inventory can be reliably offered for a given rider session and fulfilling rider requests. The group comprises several sub-teams that generate feasible offers for riders, match rider requests with drivers, and maintain a distributed state machine to track rides and drivers from request through completion.
We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Fulfillment team and lead the design, development, and deployment of state-of-the-art machine learning systems. This role requires a strategic thinker who can balance high-level system architecture with hands-on technical implementation. You will collaborate across teams to shape the future of ride-sharing by leveraging machine learning and data science.
Responsibilities:
Design, build, and deploy machine learning models for real-time applications, including translating state-of-the-art research into production-ready solutions
Design and implement feature pipelines, model training workflows, and serving infrastructure using Lyft's ML platform
Evaluate ML system performance against business KPIs, run experiments, and drive continuous model improvement
Partner with ML engineers, product managers, data scientists, and software engineers to align ML initiatives with business goals
Leverage data-driven insights to inform and refine ML strategies and solutions
Write production-level code and participate in code reviews to ensure quality and share knowledge across the team
Experience:
BS/MS in Computer Science, or a related field
2+ years of experience in machine learning modeling or related fields
Experience with deep learning technologies for recommendation systems, including TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks
Understanding of statistical concepts such as hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and performance evaluation metrics for machine learning
Experience with translating state-of-the-art ML research into production systems
Proficiency in Python, Golang, or other programming language
Proven ability to tackle ambiguous problems and deliver solutions at scale
Strong communication and interpersonal skills for effective cross-functional collaboration
Benefits:
Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future

ROLE PURPOSE Design, build and operate governed workflow, low-code, Python and ontology-based solutions that represent Wealth Brokerage and Trust business objects, decisions and work processes accurately and securely.
Job profile summary
This Software Engineer independently designs, develops, tests and maintains workflow and data-centric applications for Wealth Brokerage and Trust. The role combines professional software-engineering discipline with low-code delivery, Python development, process automation and ontology modelling.
The engineer translates business concepts such as clients, accounts, households, assets, transactions, cases, requests, approvals and items requiring attention into governed data objects, relationships, actions and workflows. Solutions must support explainable decisions, auditable processing and controlled human intervention.
The role is not ungoverned citizen development. It requires deliberate architecture, reusable components, source control, testing, deployment discipline, access controls, monitoring, support readiness and clear ownership.
Scope of responsibility
Brokerage and Trust workflow applications supporting client and account servicing, operations, review, approval, exception management and supervisory processes.
Low-code user experiences, forms, work queues, rules and automation integrated with enterprise applications, Azure services, SQL Server and approved data platforms.
Python services and utilities for data preparation, validation, enrichment, workflow logic, controls and operational automation.
Ontology models representing governed business concepts, relationships, states, actions and permissions used by applications, workflows and analytics.
Production support, controls, audit history, data lineage, observability, resilience and lifecycle management for the complete solution.
Essential Duties And Responsibilities
Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.
Design and develop governed low-code applications, workflow components, forms, work queues, business rules, notifications and operational dashboards for Brokerage and Trust.
Model end-to-end workflows covering intake, validation, classification, routing, prioritization, assignment, service levels, approvals, exception handling, escalation, completion and closure.
Design ontology objects, properties, relationships, actions and lifecycle states that accurately reflect Wealth business concepts and remain reusable across applications and analytics.
Use Python to implement data transformation, validation, enrichment, rule execution, reconciliation, automation, test utilities and supporting services where code is the appropriate mechanism.
Integrate workflow and ontology solutions with .NET/C# services, SQL Server, Azure PaaS, APIs, messaging, SFTP or managed file transfer, vendor platforms and enterprise data sources.
Implement fine-grained access, entitlements, segregation of duties, data masking, approval authority and action permissions appropriate to sensitive Wealth data and regulated processes.
Create auditable processing with clear state transitions, decision rationale, timestamps, ownership, source references, evidence and immutable history where required.
Build reusable components, ontology patterns, workflow templates and engineering standards that reduce duplication without creating a single enormous low-code contraption nobody can safely change.
Develop automated tests for Python code, workflow rules, permissions, data transformations, ontology actions and integration contracts. Support repeatable deployment and environment promotion.
Instrument applications and workflows with logging, metrics, queue ageing, throughput, exception, service-level and control-breach monitoring. Create operational runbooks and support documentation.
Partner with product, operations, data owners, risk partners and subject-matter experts to validate terminology, process states, business rules, authoritative sources and control evidence.
Assess when low code is appropriate and when complexity, scale, performance or supportability requires professionally coded services in .NET/C#, Python or Azure.
Troubleshoot production issues spanning user experience, workflow orchestration, ontology, Python, permissions, data quality, integrations and dependent platforms. Complete root-cause analysis and corrective action.
Lead design and code reviews, mentor junior engineers and contribute to governance for low-code, workflow, Python and ontology delivery across Wealth Technology.
Technical and domain expectations
Area
Grade 111 expectation
Low-code engineering
Professional delivery of applications, forms, rules and automation using approved platforms, with ALM, reusable components, testing, support and governance.
Workflow and casework
Process states, work queues, assignment, SLAs, approvals, escalations, exceptions, human tasks, controls, evidence and operational measurement.
Ontology modelling
Business objects, properties, relationships, actions, lifecycle states, semantics, lineage, permissions and reuse across applications and analytics.

. Somebody who had track record. This isn't a traditional software engineering role, and it isn't a traditional growth marketing role.

build agents and systems that do marketing at scale
.

AI Agents for Growth

Find relevant conversations about SUN, AI audio, podcasts, audiobooks, learning, and adjacent topics.

Identify high-intent users and conversations.
Generate context-aware responses while maintaining SUN's voice.
Discover creators, influencers, communities, and partnership opportunities.
Automate repetitive marketing and growth operations.
Experiment with new agentic growth loops.
The goal is simple:
turn manual growth tasks into software.

Build infrastructure that allows SUN to create once and distribute everywhere.
Own and automate distribution across:
YouTube
Spotify
Apple Podcasts
TikTok / Instagram / other social channels
Emerging AI and content platforms
Build workflows for publishing, metadata generation, thumbnails/assets, descriptions, scheduling, analytics, and repurposing.
AI Platform Distribution
Make SUN available wherever people already interact with AI.
Build and maintain integrations such as:
SUN × ChatGPT
SUN × Claude / Claude Code
SUN × Perplexity
Other AI assistants, agents, and ecosystems
Continuously look for new platforms where SUN can become a native capability rather than requiring users to discover the SUN app first.
Social Growth Systems
Help transform SUN's social presence from traditional/faceless brand accounts into
character-driven media properties
.
Build systems for:
AI characters and personalities
Content generation and repurposing
Automated publishing
Comment engagement
Content experimentation
Performance tracking
Rapid iteration based on engagement
Think of each account as an autonomous media channel powered by software.
Influencer & Ambassador Growth
Build systems that help us scale partnerships with creators, athletes, educators, and public figures.
You'll help automate:
Creator discovery
Qualification and scoring
Personalized outreach
Campaign setup
Content generation
Tracking links and attribution
Follow-ups
Campaign analytics
You'll also help execute campaigns with existing and prospective SUN ambassadors.
Distribution Experiments
Growth opportunities don't always fit neatly into engineering tickets.
You'll also launch experiments such as:
App Store distribution and optimization
New platform listings
Viral sharing mechanics
Referral loops
SEO / programmatic pages
Creator campaigns
Community growth systems
New acquisition channels
If something can bring SUN users,
you should be curious enough to test it and technical enough to automate it.
Who We're Looking For
You are an engineer who thinks like a growth hacker.
You should be comfortable going from:
idea → prototype → production → distribution → measurement
without waiting for five different teams.
You probably:
Build constantly with AI coding tools.
Have experimented with AI agents and autonomous workflows.
Are comfortable with APIs, scraping, browser automation, webhooks, queues, and third-party integrations.
Can build internal tools extremely quickly.
Understand LLM APIs and agent architectures.
Know how modern social and content platforms work.
Have strong product instincts.
Care about distribution as much as code quality.
Look at repetitive work and immediately think,
"Why isn't an agent doing this?"
Are comfortable shipping imperfect experiments, measuring them, and improving quickly.
Experience with growth engineering, consumer products, creator tools, social automation, or AI products is a strong plus.
What Success Looks Like
We don't measure this role by lines of code.
We measure it by
leverage
.
Can one system you build replace hundreds of hours of manual marketing?
Can an agent create thousands of meaningful interactions?
Can a new integration unlock an entirely new distribution channel?
Can you turn a successful manual growth experiment into software that runs continuously?
Your job is to help SUN build a
marketing machine made of software and AI agents.

NVIDIA's success builds on a foundation of industry leading hardware. We achieve distinction through extensive design optimization, including combining the best of external EDA with highly optimized, internal EDA tools. Our team develops these tools by fusing advances in parallel computing, machine learning, and specialized algorithms for VLSI design. We are seeking a R&D Software Engineer with proven experience in multiple areas of VLSI Physical Design Algorithms (sizing, buffering, CTS, legalization, incremental place and route etc.). Understanding both software and hardware aspects is the key. Creativity and self-drive to explore and perfect fast, high-capacity software is required. If you like to work across many technical areas and see your successes directly realized in the world's best AI hardware, it does not get any better than this!
Developing software within a leading hardware company means getting to almost exclusively focus on the latest processes and most advanced designs. We're not bogged down by legacy support, niche roles, or convoluted approval processes. Our developers enjoy unusually high intellectual freedom and the ability to explore broad roles.
What You’ll Be Doing
Invent new optimization engines that fuse traditionally independent engines (e.g., co-optimization of legalization and sizing) with the objective of increasing chip frequency while minimizing power consumption across a suite of internal optimization tools.
Improve algorithms (in C++) for gate-level sizing, buffering, useful clock skew, cell legalization, power minimization, ECO routing, and incremental parasitic extraction.
We as a team own the whole process from discovery and invention of new optimization opportunities, to developing solutions and working directly inside design teams to facilitate deployment.
What We Need To See
Masters or PhD in Electrical Engineer or Computer Science (or equivalent experience).
Experience with VLSI algorithms development using C++.
Understanding of VLSI timing optimization and related concepts, including cell libraries, interconnect models, crosstalk, glitches, IR drop, timing constraints, corners, congestion, etc.
Familiarity with design implementation tools such as ICC2, Innovus, PrimeTime, Tempus, and StarRC and typical design flows written in Perl, Tcl, and Python.
Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd
C++14 or newer experience, such as lambdas and concurrency.
Understanding of how multiple Physical Design steps interact and how they can potentially be fused together to form hybrid engines that result in better PPA.
Experience in high performance software design including multithreading, distributed computing, efficient memory and I/O use, etc.
Highly driven to craft software towards improving PPA with a dedication to continuous improvement.
Experience with reinforcement learning, GNNs (Graph Neural Networks), and other relevant machine learning frameworks, especially as applied to physical design.

Experience building software solutions using Azure, including at least one of the following: Functions, App Service, Storage, SQL, or API Management.
Hands‑on development experience with Azure DevOps and/or GitHub, including pull request workflows, branching strategies, issue tracking, and CI/CD.

Copilots, chatbots, or conversational user experiences

Prompt engineering and prompt or version management
Tool/function calling or agentic workflows

Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, API design, testing, and troubleshooting.
Clear communication skills with the ability to explain AI concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences.

Experience with Copilot Studio, including topics, actions, connectors, publishing, and governance.
Experience with Azure AI Foundry, including prompt flows and orchestration, evaluation, deployments, and observability.
Familiarity with Azure OpenAI or other large language model providers and model lifecycle concepts.

About the Role:
We are looking for a GTM Engineer to help us build the next generation of systems, automations, and AI-powered workflows for our go-to-market teams.Reporting to the Principal GTM Systems Architect, you will work across Salesforce, Agentforce, Workato, Zapier, Claude Code, and the broader GTM technology stack to turn business problems into practical, scalable solutions.
This is a hands-on builder role. You will partner with teams across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, Finance, and Revenue Operations to understand where work is getting stuck, identify opportunities to improve it, and build solutions that people actually use. The right person will have a strong Salesforce foundation, solid development credentials, experience with object-oriented programming, and a genuine interest in how AI is changing the way GTM teams operate.
What You'll Do:
Build and improve AI-powered workflows and agents using Salesforce Agentforce.
Develop Salesforce solutions using Flow, Apex, custom objects, permissions, APIs, and other platform capabilities.
Design and implement scalable solutions using object-oriented programming principles.
Build integrations and automations across Salesforce and the GTM stack using Workato and Zapier.
Use Claude Code and other AI development tools to prototype, build, test, and troubleshoot solutions.
Connect systems and data through APIs, webhooks, middleware, and native integrations.
Work directly with GTM teams to understand their processes and turn recurring pain points into technical solutions.
Implement enrichment and signal-detection tooling, such as Clay or similar platforms.
Design and manage signal-based and buyer-trigger analytics, including opportunity scoring and routing.
Develop and manage data models and scoring layers for customer propensity, ICP attribution, and lead and account scoring.
Support AI use cases across prospecting, account research, pipeline management, quoting, customer success, support, renewals, and internal knowledge.
Test and monitor agents and automations to ensure they are reliable, secure, and working as intended.
Troubleshoot issues across Salesforce, Agentforce, integrations, automation logic, permissions, and data.
Document and communicate what you build so solutions can be maintained and improved overtime.
Participate in sprint planning, technical design, testing, releases, and post-launch iteration.
Measure whether the solutions you build are improving adoption, efficiency, data quality, or business outcomes.
Required Qualifications:
Three or more years of experience in GTM Engineering, Salesforce, Business Systems, Revenue Operations Systems, or a similar technical role.
Strong hands-on Salesforce experience, including Flow, data modeling, permissions, APIs, automation, and production support.
Proven development experience and an understanding of object-oriented programming concepts such as classes, inheritance, and modular design.
Experience building or configuring solutions with Salesforce Agentforce.
Hands-on experience building automations and integrations in Workato and Zapier.
Experience integrating Salesforce with other business systems using APIs, webhooks, and middleware.
Working knowledge of JSON, REST APIs, authentication, data mapping, and integration troubleshooting.
Experience with Apex, Python, JavaScript, or another object-oriented language used to extend low-code platforms.
An understanding of how Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and other GTM teams operate.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work through ambiguous requirements.
Clear communication and documentation skills.
A practical mindset. You care about whether something works for the business, not just whether it is technically interesting.
Preferred Qualifications:
Salesforce Data Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Service Cloud, or Slack.
Claude Code or another AI-assisted development environment.
Model Context Protocol, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, or semantic search.
Git, Gearset, Salesforce CLI, Postman, or similar development and release tools.
GTM platforms such as Clay, LeanData, Gainsight, ZoomInfo, 6sense, or Clari.
Experience with signal-based selling, buyer-intent data, enrichment, opportunity scoring, or propensity modeling.
Salesforce certifications related to platform development, Agentforce, or Data Cloud.
You do not need experience with every tool in our environment. You should be comfortable learning new technologies and choosing the right approach for the problem, whether that means configuring Salesforce, building a Workato recipe, creating a Zap, calling an API, or writing code.
Benefits:
Specific to each country, we offer a competitive salary, stoc

Have you ever dreamed of helping bring video games to life by creating tools that empower developers to integrate innovative new graphics techniques? Do you want to work with a fast, agile, and experienced team? Are you ready to move at the speed of light?
NVIDIA is seeking a deeply technical, creative and innovative software engineer help pioneer the next generation of Graphics Developer Tools. In this role, you will work closely with our research team to develop new tools and related technologies that not only streamline graphics performance but also support emerging technologies, like neural rendering, to enhance visual quality and efficiency.
What You'll Be Doing
As a key member of the team, you will create new technical designs and implement features while working in an agile environment. You can expect to:
Improve existing tools for NVIDIA GPUs, enabling developers to quickly identify and resolve rendering and performance issues.
Create innovative new tools that bridge AI & graphics in next generation workflows.
Collaborate closely with internal and external partners, including teams within NVIDIA such as the Compiler, Driver, Research, and GPU Architecture teams.
Drive technology discussions and provide feedback on system architecture.
Accurately estimate and prioritize tasks in order to create realistic delivery schedules.
Write fast, effective, maintainable, reliable and well-documented object-oriented code.
Document requirements and designs, and review documents with key partners.
Meet with the QA Department to develop test plans for new features.
What We Need To See
BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
5+ years of relevant work experience in software development
Real passion for 3D graphics, AI, and low-level programming with 5+ years of relevant industry experience.
Excellent C/C++ programming skills.
Ability to provide accurate estimates to ensure delivery of software on time.
Knowledge of 3D Graphics Algorithms and GPU Architectures, with proficiency in at least one 3D Graphics API such as Direct3D, OpenGL, or Vulkan.
Demonstrated experience with AI and deep learning techniques, including familiarity with neural network architectures, CUDA, and frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Deep understanding of computer architecture concepts such as virtual memory, caches, registers, threads, and heterogeneous computing.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd
Familiarity with deep learning and AI, particularly in applying these technologies to enhance graphics performance and quality.
Background in the game industry, research, or in a field that requires high-performance graphics.
Be able to demonstrate initiative and determination to get things done.
NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers with some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working here.
If you're highly technical and enthusiastic about 3D Graphics, we want to hear from you! For two decades, we have pioneered visual computing, the art and science of computer graphics. With our invention of the GPU - the engine of modern visual computing - the field has expanded to encompass video games, movie production, product design, medical diagnosis and scientific research. Today, we stand at the beginning of the next era, the AI computing era, ignited by a new computing model, GPU deep learning.

Who We Are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About The Team
The Solutions Architecture (SA) organization helps Stripe's most strategic customers design and validate technical solutions that drive their business forward. Within SA, our team builds the tools, workflows, and custom technical assets that make the broader SA org more effective—turning individual ingenuity into org-wide capability.
We are looking for AI Engineers who are energized by working close to the business and the users we serve. You'll operate as an embedded, high-context engineer focused on the highest-leverage opportunities across the SA org—building production-quality tooling, supporting our most strategic engagements, and shipping automation that meaningfully improves how Solutions Architects work every day.
What You'll Do
As an AI Engineer, you'll be embedded directly with the Solutions Architecture team—building alongside them, deeply understanding their workflows, and shipping tools and automation that permanently change how they operate. Your measure of success is SA productivity: the engagements you've accelerated, the workflows you've transformed, and the tools you've built that the org adopts as default.
You'll ship code daily. You'll discover where SAs lose time and build high-impact solutions. You'll take what works for one person and scale it to work for the org. And when our most strategic customer engagements need custom technical assets, you'll build those too.
This is a role for someone who wants to work at the intersection of engineering and business impact—close to customers, close to revenue, and building for people you can see using your work every day.

Collaborate with Solutions Architects, SA leadership, Product, and Engineering to scope technical work and translate ambiguous business needs into well-defined deliverables
Evaluate and integrate AI capabilities (LLMs, agents, workflow automation) where they provide genuine leverage—not for novelty, but for measurable productivity improvement

Take high-potential tools and workflows built by SAs and managers and harden them into scalable, maintainable, production-grade solutions
Identify patterns across SA workflows and proactively build solutions that address recurring friction

Document tools, architectures, and usage patterns so others can adopt and extend what you've built
Debug, extend, and maintain backend systems across a variety of codebases and infrastructure

Strong backend engineering fundamentals: you can debug a failing system, trace issues across services, and reason about data flows

Experience scoping and delivering work with minimal oversight in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment

Experience building internal tools, developer platforms, or workflow automation
Demonstrated ability to work across multiple codebases and technology stacks simultaneously

Track record of building tools or systems that were adopted beyond your immediate team
Background in consulting, professional services, or other roles that blend technical depth with business context

Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About The Team
Stripe Infrastructure is responsible for the reliability, scale, performance, and cost of Stripe's systems and the productivity and sentiment of Stripe's people.
You may work on a wide variety of critical business areas including:
Core Infrastructure—We're the home for Stripe's critical tier0 infrastructure systems (Compute, Networking, DocumentDB, Distributed Caching and High assurance engineering). We build the foundational platform for Stripe products and services to allow them to operate at scale. We drive reliability, availability, efficiency, and scalability of these systems.
Developer Infrastructure—We're responsible for the productivity of all developers at Stripe. Ensure Stripe's engineers have a reliable, fast, and easy-to-use inner dev loop to maximize productivity while building everything from low-latency microservices to large-scale data pipelines and machine learning models.
Data Infrastructure—We're responsible for offering data serving infrastructure spanning across data warehouse analytics, streaming analytics, and search capabilities. The stack is supported by a collection of internally developed large-scale distributed services and several popular open-source technologies like Trino/Presto, Apache Pinot, Hive Metastore, ElasticSearch etc. The systems we own support all of the data serving needs of high-scale services and thousands of individual Stripes across the company.
Admin Platform—We empower Stripes to quickly build secure and delightful internal products in service of their users.
Service Platform—We enable engineering teams at Stripe to easily write and ship useful services that correctly, reliably, and efficiently leverage platform capabilities.
Developer Productivity AI—We're responsible for doubling Stripe's engineering velocity through effective use of LLMs. We own Minions, Stripe's one-shot, end-to-end coding agents.
Team matching—exact team matching for one of the subteams will begin during final stages. Please note we may also consider you for different orgs based on your experience, location, etc. Find more information on our team matching process here.
What you'll do
You'll work on projects that span technologies, systems, and processes where you'll design, build, test, and ship great code every day.
Responsibilities
Build a great customer experience for internal and external Stripe teams using our infrastructure
Participate in roadmap planning and prioritization
Deliver value through a strong collaborative approach with multiple customers and stakeholders across Stripe
Debug production issues across services and several levels of the stack
Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum Requirements
Strong software engineering skills and a passion for one of the areas above
Ability to write high-quality code (in programming languages like Go, Java, C/C++ etc.)
2–12+ years of professional hands-on software development experience, able to write well-factored algorithms and have experience with commonly used data structures and algorithms
Hands-on experience contributing to or building large-scale distributed systems
Strong collaboration skills, can work across workstreams within your team and contribute to your peers' success
Customer obsession, ability to articulate and represent customer experience in various forums to drive the right outcome
Have the ability to thrive on a high level of autonomy and responsibility, and think of yourself as entrepreneurial
Preferred Qualifications
Experience optimizing the end-to-end performance of distributed systems
Focus on the needs of our users, both internal and external
Hold yourself and others to a high bar when working with production
Hybrid work at Stripe
This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).
In-office expectations
Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.
Working remotely at Stripe
A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.
Pay and benefits
The annual US base salary range for this role is $142,600 - $213,800. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location

Your opportunity
New Relic's whole platform runs on an assumption: by the time a request reaches any service, someone has already answered two questions, who is this, and what are they allowed to do. Amazon LEO is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.
We are seeking a Software Development Engineer to help drive design and implementation of software systems that control, monitor, and manage star tracker flight hardware, including real-time device control, remote management, Linux integration, software build systems and release validation testing.
Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Design, develop, and optimize highly reliable flight software for Star Tracker flight systems, spanning low-level device drivers and real-time control loops to high-level autonomous behaviors, fault management, and AI/ML-driven decision-making that target Linux environments

As a Software Engineer on the OISL Star Tracker team, you won't just write code - you'll see it in action. Experience with remote device management at scale (OTA updates, fleet provisioning, configuration management)

We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.
Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.
Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.
As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

About The Role
The Grading Operations software engineering team builds and operates the internal software that runs our grading and authentication business. That means the applications our operations teams work in every day, the services and APIs behind them, the scheduled and event-driven processes that move items through the grading lifecycle, and the integrations that connect all of it to adjacent systems across the platform.
Volume climbs every year and the systems have kept up. As our grading operations reach more markets, keeping pace means solving for distance as well as volume.
This is a role for an engineer who wants projects that do not have an obvious solution yet. You will own complex, loosely defined projects, take the lead when they span other engineering teams, and help raise the design bar across the team. The breadth is unusual for one role: a containerized core application, serverless services, event-driven pipelines, and the applications our operations teams work in all day. Build backend services, APIs, and data models that power the internal applications our grading and authentication teams rely on every day
Work across a mix of architectures, from a large containerized .NET application to smaller serverless APIs and Python background processing jobs, and help decide which is the right fit for new work
Design and implement event-driven and asynchronous systems that keep operational data flowing reliably at high volume
Mentor other engineers on the team through design review, code review, and the way you work through hard problems

Collaborate with Product, Tech, and Operations teams to translate business requirements into clean technical designs across both backend and frontend systems

Write design documents and technical decision records that other engineers build against

Routine use of AI tooling as part of how you design and build software, with the judgment to review and take responsibility for what it produces

As a Systems Engineer for the Processor IPT, you will work closely with a multidisciplinary team of engineers to ensure the successful design and manufacturing of the Processor on the PAC-3 Seeker to meet the performance, reliability, and safety requirements of the seeker system. A successful candidate will be responsible for development and adherence of the Processor requirements and the interfaces of the Processor with the rest of the Seeker system.
Boeing Defense, Space & Security (BDS) Patriot Advanced Capability (PAC-3) program is an air-defense missile system designed to counter tactical ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and advanced aircraft where Boeing is the original engineering manufacturer of the seeker. The PAC-3 Seeker team is a cross functional, highly skilled, motivated group embracing the beliefs that focused safety, execution, LEAN manufacturing and business practices will secure our future and well-being, driving our product to be the seeker of choice for the PAC-3 program and future generations of weapon systems.

Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential
As a Software Engineer / Lead Software Engineer in Enterprise Technology (ET) Claims, you will join the Enterprise Claim System (ECS) Build team, the team that owns CI/CD pipeline infrastructure, build automation, and release engineering for one of State Farm's largest and most complex applications. ECS spans 40+ product modules across concurrent release streams, compiled and deployed through scheduled full-system builds orchestrated by both a legacy Jenkins cluster and an evolving GitLab CI platform. You will drive the modernization of this ecosystem, migrating Jenkins jobs to GitLab CI pipelines (with GitHub on the long-term horizon), evolving builds from Ant/Maven toward Gradle, and building the shared tooling and automation that keeps hundreds of Claims developers productive.
What You Will Do
Design, implement, and maintain GitLab CI pipelines that compile, package, and validate a large-scale Java application across multiple concurrent release streams using shared AWS runners and custom Docker images.

Automate release operations: branch/tag management across multi-stream releases, version management, configuration-only builds, and externalized configuration.
